answer: Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted vouchers. Each agent locks real tokens behind a reputation bond, and one sponsor can back only a capped number of identities. Every new agent also needs a live voucher signed by three bonded peers who lose stake if it misbehaves. Duplicating an identity thus requires fresh bonds and vouchers each time, so cost scales with the number of fakes instead of staying flat. A lone falcon cannot hide a flock of copies in the haven of cheap accounts; each forged ember needs its own collateral to burn.
